title: Isolation of human NK subsets
protocol: Isolate peripheral blood lymphocytes from different healthy donors using Ficoll gradients.
Isolate NK cells using the NK isolation kit II (Miltenyi Biotec).
Sort 100 X 10^6 cells enriched for CD56+CD3-NK cells to purify CD56dimCD16+CD3- and CD56brightCD16-CD3- subsets.
Subject isolated pbNK cells to the same isolation protocol used for dNK cells to rule out methodological differences.
Wash cells in PBS supplemented with 2% FCS.
Incubate cells with mAb on ice for 30 min.
Cell sort and measure fluorescence on a MoFlo high performance cell sorter.
Collect data from single cell events using a standard FACScaliburTM flow cytometer.
Highly purify peripheral blood NK subsets to obtain CD56dimCD16+CD3- (pbCD16+ NK) and CD56brightCD16-CD3- (pbCD16-) subsets.
Perform intracellular staining with a Cytoperm-Cytofix Intracellular Staining kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
